> # worldsteel Short Range Outlook — April 2026
>
> - Publisher: World Steel Association (worldsteel)
> - Published: 2026-04-14
> - URL: https://worldsteel.org/media/press-releases/2026/worldsteel-short-range-outlook-april-2026/
> - Collected: 2026-08-19
>
> worldsteel forecast global finished-steel demand of 1,724 Mt in 2026, 0.3% above 2025, followed
> by 2.2% growth to 1,762 Mt in 2027. The October 2025 release had forecast 1,773 Mt and 1.3%
> growth for 2026, so the April 2026 forecast reduced the 2026 level by 49 Mt and the growth rate
> by 1.0 percentage point.
>
> For China, worldsteel reported an official 7.1% contraction in 2025, compared with its October
> 2025 forecast of a 2.0% contraction. It forecast a further 1.5% contraction in 2026. India was
> forecast to expand by 7.4% in 2026 and 9.2% in 2027. Developed-world demand in 2025 remained
> about 60 Mt, or 15%, below 2017–2018 levels. Korea and other major developed economies were
> expected to return to positive growth in 2027, not necessarily in 2026.
>
> The outlook assumed resolution of the Middle East conflict by June 2026 and warned that a
> longer conflict would require downward revisions, particularly in energy-sensitive regions.
>
> This archived note is a factual extraction from the official public page. Calculated differences
> between the October 2025 and April 2026 releases are marked as arithmetic comparisons, not as
> figures stated verbatim by worldsteel.
